description: SMA vs EMA divergence scenario: 7 closes with a peak-then-decline pattern (period=3, alpha=2/(3+1)=0.5). SMA and EMA seed identically at index 0 (both = mean of first 3 closes = 4.0). EMA then lags the SMA on the rising side and leads on the falling side due to alpha-weighting. Both produce 5 output values. Verifies: (1) SMA and EMA seed equal on first value; (2) EMA reacts faster to price changes than SMA on upswing; (3) EMA decays faster than SMA on downswing. All values cross-verified with Go implementation.

expectedOutput.note: alpha=0.5 (standard, not Wilder). EMA seed = SMA of closes[0:3] = (2+4+6)/3 = 4.0. SMA and EMA diverge at index 2: SMA=6.667 (window mean), EMA=6.0 (weighted). EMA leads the decline: index 4 EMA=3.5 vs SMA=4.0.
